en: A color postcard showing an outdoor concert by a municipal brass band performing in a historic European square surrounded by pastel-colored buildings and a large audience seated on temporary bleachers and behind barriers. At the center-right of the square stands an ornate baroque fountain with statues, and in the background is a domed building with a tiled roof. The band members wear blue uniforms and play various wind and percussion instruments while facing the crowd. At the bottom of the postcard there is large printed text in Italian.
